video_title: Indiana Pacers Postgame Media Availability (vs.Hawks) | October 10, 2026

quotes.speaker: Rick Carlisle
quotes.summary_phrase: Rick Carlisle identifies key areas for improvement after loss
quotes.excerpt: We are going to have to do better with turnovers, we are going to have to do better with fouling.
quotes.quote: We are going to have to do better with turnovers, we are going to have to do better with fouling, and rebounding was a problem. So, those are big areas of concern just as I glance at the stat sheet. Rick turnovers and fouling may be a big part of this, but you gave up 32 points per quarter for the first three quarters.
quotes.social_post: Rick Carlisle identified turnovers, fouling, and rebounding as the primary areas of concern for the Pacers following their loss to the Hawks. He noted these are big areas of concern just as he glances at the stat sheet.

quotes.speaker: Rick Carlisle
quotes.summary_phrase: Rick Carlisle praises Larry Nance Jr.'s veteran presence
quotes.excerpt: Larry Nance Jr. is a knowledgeable veteran player with feel who knows how to play the game.
quotes.quote: Larry Nance Jr. is a knowledgeable veteran player with feel who knows how to play the game. He has been a good defender and rebounder in his career and again, he is just very smart, good communicator.
quotes.social_post: Rick Carlisle praised Larry Nance Jr. for his veteran presence, calling him a knowledgeable player with feel who is a good communicator and defender.

quotes.speaker: Rick Carlisle
quotes.summary_phrase: Rick Carlisle discusses depth and flexibility at center position
quotes.excerpt: Our center position, we have got some options there with James Wiseman, Obi Toppin, Jalen Smith and Larry Nance Jr.
quotes.quote: Our center position, we have got some options there with James Wiseman, Obi Toppin, Jalen Smith and Larry Nance Jr. Obi Toppin is a natural four-man and Larry Nance Jr. can play some four if needed. So, there is some good possibilities there.
quotes.social_post: Rick Carlisle discussed the flexibility of the Pacers frontcourt, noting that with James Wiseman, Obi Toppin, Jalen Smith, and Larry Nance Jr., there are good possibilities for the center and power forward positions.

quotes.speaker: Rick Carlisle
quotes.summary_phrase: Rick Carlisle on the adjustment period for new players
quotes.excerpt: It takes a while to get in this kind of condition to play fast at the level we play at.
quotes.quote: It is going to be a continuous adjustment for the guys that are the new guys that have not been here. It takes a while to get in this kind of condition to play fast at the level we play at. A lot of players will tell you that they want to run, they want to play fast, until they find out what the commitment is from a conditioning standpoint.
quotes.social_post: Rick Carlisle says the adjustment period for new Pacers players is ongoing, noting that many players want to play fast until they find out what the commitment is from a conditioning standpoint.

quotes.speaker: Pascal Siakam
quotes.summary_phrase: Pascal Siakam on building chemistry and two-man game
quotes.excerpt: I was telling him in the game, look at my side a little bit more, do some two-man game.
quotes.quote: I was telling him in the game, look at my side a little bit more, do some two-man game. I think we can do some damage with that. He is a really good passer, I have to continue to learn, continue to cut, especially with someone like him that can make some of those passes.
quotes.social_post: Pascal Siakam is looking to build more chemistry with his teammates, specifically mentioning he wants to run more two-man game to do some damage on the court.

quotes.speaker: Pascal Siakam
quotes.summary_phrase: Pascal Siakam emphasizes defense as the key to playing time
quotes.excerpt: The only way you are going to get minutes is the same thing, by playing defense.
quotes.quote: The only way you are going to get minutes is the same thing, by playing defense. We have enough scorers, I feel like. If you can stand out, making the right plays, being good on defense, then you find yourself out there for 30 minutes, then your talent shows a lot more.
quotes.social_post: Pascal Siakam says defense is the only way to earn minutes in the Pacers rotation. He believes the team has enough scorers and that players who stand out on defense will find themselves playing 30 minutes.

quotes.speaker: Pascal Siakam
quotes.summary_phrase: Pascal Siakam evaluates the fit of new teammate
quotes.excerpt: He is a wing defender, can knock down the three, I think he has good energy about him.
quotes.quote: He is a wing defender, can knock down the three, I think he has good energy about him. He is bought into playing the way we play. I think underrated driver, I feel like he can really drive and make plays or finishes and he can also space the floor.
quotes.social_post: Pascal Siakam praised a new teammate for his energy and fit, describing him as a wing defender who can knock down the three and is an underrated driver.

quotes.speaker: Braden Smith
quotes.summary_phrase: Braden Smith on feedback from teammates regarding his play
quotes.excerpt: They are just telling me to be super aggressive all the time offensively, look for my shot.
quotes.quote: They are just telling me to be super aggressive all the time offensively, look for my shot, go, kind of the T.J. McConnell pace, just looking for that off the baseline and that kind of stuff. My job when I come in is just try to push the pace, get guys the ball in open space and create and make shots.
quotes.social_post: Braden Smith says his veteran teammates are encouraging him to be super aggressive offensively and push the pace, similar to the style of T.J. McConnell.

quotes.speaker: Braden Smith
quotes.summary_phrase: Braden Smith on learning from veteran teammates
quotes.excerpt: For me it is just doesn't matter if it is playmaking, ball handling, whatever it is.
quotes.quote: For me it is just doesn't matter if it is playmaking, ball handling, whatever it is, you can learn so much just from being on the court with them, watching them. It is nice to just be able to have a bunch of different people you can pick certain parts from and pieces to be able to take.
quotes.social_post: Braden Smith says he is focused on learning from his veteran teammates, noting that he can pick up different pieces of playmaking and ball handling just by watching them on the court.

quotes.speaker: Braden Smith
quotes.summary_phrase: Braden Smith reflects on missed final shot
quotes.excerpt: I honestly think I should have shot the mid-range going baseline, it is the shot I've made a living on.
quotes.quote: I honestly think I should have shot the mid-range going baseline, it is the shot I have made a living on. So I think that is probably what I should have shot. But obviously I thought he closed out pretty hard, so I shot faked and then I had the up and under and I just missed it.
quotes.social_post: Braden Smith reflected on his missed final shot against the Hawks, admitting he should have taken the mid-range jumper he has made a living on instead of opting for the up and under.
